base: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game-animation atlas, EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS, 48 full-body figures, 1536x2048 transparent PNG, uniform 256x256 cells. Column1 left-stride walk; column2 passing; column3 right-stride walk; column4 passing; column5 relaxed standing feet flat side by side arms down; column6 same standing breath. Each row SIX sprites all face SAME direction. Rows top to bottom S front, SW front three-quarter down-left, W left profile, NW rear three-quarter up-left, N full back, NE rear three-quarter up-right, E right profile, SE front three-quarter down-right. NW,N,NE NO FACE visible. Exactly eight rows including SE. Character centred x128 in each cell soles at y240, margin16 all edges. Original hand-painted FULL COLOUR chibi large head small body, thin dark outline, detailed soft painted shading, match the Amiya sheet style. Input full-art only reference for costume and colours, redraw from scratch. Transparent real alpha background, no text, no grid lines, no shadows, no ground, no glow, no logos. No fighting, weapons carried at REST, never raised. Distinct four gait poses, calm everyday base walking. Critical: row7 is E pure RIGHT PROFILE for ALL SIX columns, including standing! Row8 SE is separate front-right three-quarter. Keep both.

identities.stormeye: STORMEYE: tall lean male, swept-back GREY hair, pointed ears, large CLEAR visor with BLACK gas mask, dark tactical suit sparse cyan trim. Recurve bow AND quiver strapped on BACK (not held). Rear rows show bow/quiver over shoulders. Grey hair and gas mask must contrast with Sharp's dark beard. Match exact reference costume.
identities.pith: PITH: white-haired slim woman with ONE bright cyan hair streak, swept back BLACK feather ears, dark mouth mask. Long dark ragged hem coat with grey-blue lining, thigh-high black boots. Very long dark STAFF held LOW diagonally beside body in one hand (stay within cell); never attack. Cyan streak and long coat distinguish from reserve specialist. No bow or quiver. Match exact reference costume.
identities.touch: TOUCH: black hood with TWO curved horns, orange-tinted ski goggles, white mouth mask, WHITE/GREY LONG COAT over black tactical kit, lightest crew silhouette, black boots. MACE-HEADED STAFF UPRIGHT resting like walking stick in one hand. Horns and orange goggles clear. Match exact reference costume.
identities.tulip: TULIP: slim tall woman, very wide-brim BLACK HAT, long wavy SILVER hair down to waist, pointed elf ears, BLACK eye visor. Long black ragged coat, legs in black. Thin cane carried LOW in one hand. Hat is broad and unmistakable. Match reference costume.
identities.mechanist: MECHANIST: male full BLACK HELMET with wide YELLOW visor, TWO antennae with YELLOW tips. YELLOW-AND-BLACK jacket, ONLY yellow figure in crew, black trousers boots. HUGE mechanical backpack with TOOL ARM FOLDED tightly at rest. Back rows show backpack and folded tool arm. No face visible. Match reference costume.
identities.misery: MISERY: slim male slicked dark hair with SILVER SPIKY CREST piece above forehead. YELLOW goggles. Slim dark tactical suit sparse cyan seams. Distinct YELLOW-ORANGE BACKPACK. Knife SHEATHED. Bare head with hair and crest, NOT a helmet, NOT yellow jacket; only backpack/goggles yellow. Match reference costume.

prompts.sharp: Use case: stylized-concept. A production game-animation atlas for Arknights Sharp, 1536x2048 transparent PNG. All six figures in EACH row face SAME direction. Eight rows top to bottom S front, SW front three-quarter down-left, W left profile, NW rear three-quarter up-left, N full back, NE rear three-quarter up-right, E right profile, SE front three-quarter down-right. In NW,N,NE absolutely NO face or goggles visible. Same foot baseline 240 inside each cell; same body centre x128. Leave 16px margin. Style reference attached Amiya sheet: painted full-colour chibi large head and small body, thin dark outlines, detailed shading; match that style, NOT photoreal. Reference Sharp full art is costume/colour only, fresh redraw, do not trace. Sharp identity mandatory: broad heavy muscular dark-skinned man with short DARK hair, thick DARK beard, black goggles across eyes, dark tactical uniform with sparse cyan seams, radio antenna on shoulder. LARGE RECTANGULAR black shield STRAPPED ON HIS BACK, machete SHEATHED at hip, arms relaxed. Back rows clearly show shield rectangle on back. Everyday unhurried walk, never fighting, weapons stay at rest. Distinct limb poses in four walk columns. Standing columns feet flat. Real transparent background, no shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no logo, no glow. Do not skip the last row. Each character completely contained in its cell.
